# A command step of a round item commits a file in the worktree. The agent step after it is lost with a clean worktree.
# Someone removes the worktree while no run is alive. The next run recovers the agent step. The commit of the earlier step went with the
# removed worktree. The worktree made again holds no start mark, so the note claims no change and names no file: it says the worktree is
# not the one that the step started in.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
# The script tests the round, not the sandbox, so its project keeps the sandbox off, though the fixture project file sets it on.
replace config/projects/local.star 'sandbox = "on"' 'sandbox = "off"'
subst flow/round.star
subst fake/claude
chmod 755 fake/claude

exec beehestreal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehestreal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star &
waitfile started
kill -KILL
wait

# The first start of the agent ran at the commit of the earlier step.
cmp pre.head agent.head.1

rm state/trees/local/round_2Fintegration_2Fr1

exec sh any.sh run run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
grep 'item round/integration/r1 finished' run.out

exists prompt.2
! grep EARLIER_STEP prompt.2
! grep 'could not read the diff summary' prompt.2
! grep 'The engine found no change to tracked files since the step started' prompt.2
! grep 'The engine read this summary of the changes' prompt.2
grep 'The work tree is not the one that the step started in' prompt.2

-- any.sh --
label=$1
shift
beehestreal "$@" > "$label.out" 2> "$label.err"
echo $? > "$label.rc"
-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    command(name = "pre", run = ["sh", "-c", "echo x > EARLIER_STEP && git add EARLIER_STEP && git -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m earlier && git rev-parse HEAD > @WORK@/pre.head"])
    agent(name = "probe", prompt = "prompts/probe.md", model = "m")
-- flow/prompts/probe.md --
Probe the folder.
-- fake/claude --
#!/bin/sh
if [ "${1:-}" = "--version" ]; then echo 1.0.0; exit 0; fi
n=$(cat "@WORK@/starts" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
n=$((n + 1))
echo "$n" > "@WORK@/starts"
cat > "@WORK@/prompt.$n"
git rev-parse HEAD > "@WORK@/agent.head.$n"
if [ "$n" -eq 1 ]; then echo x > "@WORK@/started"; sleep 30; fi
echo '{"type":"result","session_id":"s1","result":"done"}'
